summary: Fix two ways blob bytes in their own file (#6894) could fail to open a store: a daemon with store_dir set failed to start on an existing store, and a read-only open of a store with no blob file yet failed. Every build from #6894 up to this fix has both.

replay.detail: No claim, replication or digest change.

schema.detail: No schema change. The blob file is created with the same settings as before (incremental auto-vacuum, WAL).

compatibility.detail: Builds from #6894 up to this fix fail to start a daemon whose config sets store_dir once its store exists without a blob file (an upgrade from before #6894, or a blob file removed): 'unable to open database: .../claims.blobs.sqlite3'. Those builds also fail a read-only open (a CLI or status read before any writer of a blob-file build) with 'attempt to write a readonly database'. This build creates the blob file through a connection that may, and a reader with no blob file attaches the store's own file in its place, so a read-only open writes nothing.

manual.detail: A member on an affected build with store_dir set that fails to start: upgrade to this build. No data was changed.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to an affected build brings both failures back; rolling back to a release before #6894 is unaffected.
